_meta.title: Outpaint Expand v1
_meta.description: Extend the canvas on one or more sides and fill the new area with AI-generated content that continues the source image. Uses ComfyUI's built-in 'Pad Image for Outpainting' node to build the padded canvas and mask, then the same inpaint backbone as inpaint-fill-v1.json.
_meta.status: GPU-run verified 2026-09-02 on Apple M1 Pro/Metal (P-043) — loaded into a real ComfyUI and run to a saved image; checkpoint loading fixed from a nonexistent single-file name to UNETLoader+DualCLIPLoader+VAELoader, see workflows/README.md

2._note: Injected at runtime by the caller.

3._note: Built-in ComfyUI core node. Pads the canvas and produces the outpaint mask in one step — direction sizes are caller-supplied, 256px each is a placeholder default.

inputs.text: seam, hard edge, discontinuity, lowres, bad quality, blurry, watermark
